configurationBoundary.scope: GA4 Reports tab and GA4 report delivery surfaces
includedSurfaces: GA4 Reports tab and saved GA4 report library
browser-generated Overview, KPI, Benchmark, Ad Comparison, Insights, and Custom GA4 PDFs
server-generated test-send, manual, direct-snapshot, and scheduled GA4 PDFs
GA4 report snapshots, send events, direct snapshot routes, and scheduler bookkeeping
excludedSurfaces: Campaign DeepDive Custom Reports, lists, scheduling, aggregate inputs, and PDFs
independent certification of non-GA4 connected-platform reports
future email-provider availability or future recipient inbox behavior
production-data cleanup not bounded by a proven damaged-row inventory
sourceRules: use the saved campaign, GA4 property, source filter, KPI, benchmark, and financial-source configuration
do not replace a missing selected source value with an unrelated aggregate
preserve revenue, spend, attribution, and source-provenance semantics across every consumer
windowRules: use the report-type live or persisted reporting window documented for the surface
apply completed-day and reporting-timezone rules consistently
prove browser and server artifact parity for the same authoritative fixture
ownershipRules: enforce tenant, client, campaign, platform, report, and snapshot ownership boundaries
fail closed when campaign or platform ownership cannot be proven
require snapshot and report campaign-platform consistency
deliveryRules: a generated PDF is required but does not prove numerical correctness
provider API acceptance is not confirmed delivery
sent snapshots and last-sent bookkeeping must represent confirmed successful sends
scheduler processing must be deduplicated and idempotent

dependencies.role: GA4 Reports tab UI and browser artifact consumer
report API, access, CRUD, generation, and delivery routes
report preflight KPI and benchmark processing
report email composition and provider submission
report scheduler and email regression evidence
deployed scheduler and runtime configuration boundary
